0022600186.text: The Miami Heat (2-5, 10th in the East) visit the LA Clippers (1-6, 13th in the West) after dropping their last game, and Miami sits fourth in the Southeast, 2 games back. The Clippers have lost six straight and are 4.5 games back in fourth place in the Pacific, and they are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 140-123 win in Miami on December 1, 2025.
